arithmetic.herfindahlWorking: 0.75 squared is 0.5625, 0.20 squared is 0.04, 0.05 squared is 0.0025, and those sum to 0.605.
arithmetic.floatNote: 0.2 and 0.05 have no exact binary representation, yet this particular set of three squares happens to sum back to exactly 0.605 in double precision. The test asserts closeness rather than equality, because that coincidence is a property of these three numbers and not of the formula.
